name: ztm
notes: IPv4 only; dedicated private /30 link configured separately on each host.
15 containers: 2 web, 2 auth, 2 API, 2 Redis, 2 Postgres, 4 inert decoys, 1 simulation controller.
Postgres instances have independent lab data, not streaming replication.
Only web addresses are routed to Host 2; application/data bridges are unnumbered.
Controller runs M1 simulation only; live telemetry integration begins in M3/M4.
Runtime sysctls only; prepare prints a plan unless --apply is supplied.
Bridge filtering on each container veth covers same-bridge traffic in M5.
